<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

<StackPane xmlns="http://javafx.com/javafx"
           xmlns:fx="http://javafx.com/fxml"
           prefWidth="1920" prefHeight="1080"
           styleClass="screen">

    <VBox alignment="CENTER" spacing="24">

        <Label text="Asiatik Express" styleClass="brand"/>

        <Button text="TOUCHEZ POUR COMMENCER"
                styleClass="cta"/>

        <Label text="Commandez vos plats en quelques étapes"
               styleClass="subtitle"/>

        <HBox spacing="16" alignment="CENTER">
            <Button text="FR" styleClass="ghost"/>
            <Button text="EN" styleClass="ghost"/>
            <Button text="Aide" styleClass="ghost"/>
        </HBox>

    </VBox>
</StackPane>
